title: An idea becomes a connected system — gouache dusk valley

scenes.title: The idea is painted
scenes.purpose: Establish the dusk gouache valley and paint the ochre idea ring and headline.
visuals: Static dusk sky of directional dabs swirling around the idea
Ochre idea ring brushed in as one circular stroke
Far slate hill repainted left to right
Headline brush-wiped in, then the subtitle rises
assets: index.html canvas layers: sky, orb, far hill, grain

beats.development: The ring stroke closes around the warm core (0.15-1.0s), the far hill sweep starts at 0.25s, the headline is wiped in at 0.1-0.8s and the subtitle fades in at 0.6-1.15s.

scenes.title: The valley and village form
scenes.purpose: Layer the scenery and settle the village where the idea will land.
visuals: Mid hill repainted in a dry-brush sweep
Gold beam dabbed from the ring down to the central house
assets: index.html canvas layers: mid hill, foreground rust field, houses

beats.development: Houses settle at 1.0-1.75s, the beam draws at 1.15-1.65s, the mid hill completes by 1.45s, and the central house's windows light at 1.68s.

scenes.title: Connected system
scenes.purpose: Spread light along the dashed path so every house is connected, then hold the readable scene.
visuals: Cream-gold dash dabs travel left and right from the central house
Windows light warm orange as each connection arrives
assets: index.html canvas: dashed links, window glow

beats.development: Links reach the right-centre house (2.02s), the left house (2.15s) and the far-right house (2.32s), and each one's windows light up.
Final reading hold on the complete connected valley.

findings: All motion completes by 2.6s, so the full readable scene holds from 2.6s to 3.0s.
The footer stays static and readable throughout on the dark rust field.
justifiedHolds: The 0.4s closing hold lets the viewer read the connected system.

notes: Background policy is scene-dependent: a dusk indigo field replaces the prior cream swatch.
Renderer: Canvas 2D. Motion owner: one GSAP timeline.
